sections.heading: Integrateoperator
sections.content: The Integrate operator allows you to immediately integrate particle properties, instead of at the end of the timestep.

sections.heading: Properties to integrate
sections.content: Spin/velocity: controls which particle properties will be integrated.

sections.heading: Integration action
sections.content:
Integrate value: adds the spin/velocity value of the particle to the position of the particle immediately.Do nothing: no integration action will be taken.

Integrate value: adds the spin/velocity value of the particle to the position of the particle immediately.

Do nothing: no integration action will be taken.

sections.heading: Post-integration action
sections.content:
Keep value: after the spin/velocity is integrated, the particle’s spin/velocity value is left unchanged.Clear value: after the spin/velocity is integrated, the particle’s spin/velocity value is cleared (set to zero).Flag value as already integrated: after the spin/velocity is integrated, the particle’s spin/velocity value is left unchanged but also flagged internally as already integrated, so that it won’t be re-integrated at the end of the time step.

Keep value: after the spin/velocity is integrated, the particle’s spin/velocity value is left unchanged.

Clear value: after the spin/velocity is integrated, the particle’s spin/velocity value is cleared (set to zero).

Flag value as already integrated: after the spin/velocity is integrated, the particle’s spin/velocity value is left unchanged but also flagged internally as already integrated, so that it won’t be re-integrated at the end of the time step.
